Sam Rivera: Heads-up — spotted a tiny but annoying issue in the runbook: the 'deploy rollback' snippet links to a deprecated S3 path and the curl example still uses `--old-flag`. Can someone grab a quick patch? https://internal.kb/runbooks/deploy#rollback
Rita Patel: ugh, nice catch. I hit that yesterday when testing canary.
Ken Liu: can you paste the exact snippet? I can do a 1-line PR if it's just the URL and flag.
Sam Rivera: sure — here's the block (copied from the page):
```
curl -X POST https://s3.redwood-internal.com/runbooks/deploy/rollback.sh --old-flag 
```
The new path should be `https://artifacts.redwood-infra/runbooks/rollback.sh` and flag -> `--force-rollback`.
Rita Patel: thanks. also the anchor fragment `#rollback` 404s from the TOC — may need a small frontmatter change.
Docs Bot: Automated link-scan: flagged 1 broken anchor in /runbooks/deploy (detected 2026-03-20 03:22 UTC).
Jordan M.: I'm about to cut a tiny docs batch. If Ken doesn't pick it up in 20m I can include this.
Ken Liu: I can do it now. Will open a PR that updates the curl snippet, fixes the anchor id, and add a quick changelog note. PR will be small, pinging @Rita for QA.
Rita Patel: happy to review after lunch. Can you add a brief test step in the runbook saying 'verify link resolves' so we don't regress?
Ken Liu: will do — adding a one-liner checklist item. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4892
Sam Rivera: amazing, thanks. No rush but appreciated — leaving a quick note in the sprint board too. :thumbsup:
Docs Bot: PR 4892 queued for docs-merge; awaiting approvals.
Ken Liu: marking this thread done once merged, will post back here with merge TS.
Sam Rivera: thanks everyone!
